sources.title: Christian Clason, Regularization of Inverse Problems: Lecture Notes, arXiv:2001.00617v2 (2021)
sources.locator: Complete 137-page PDF. Chapter 11 §11.2: equations (11.14)–(11.17), Theorem 11.8 and full proof, Lemma 11.9 and full proof, Assumption 11.10, and Theorem 11.11 and full proof through the logarithmic stopping bound.
sources.disposition: Primary full-lecture-notes treatment for the residual-forcing regularized LM step, range approximation, Fejér estimate, and local discrepancy stopping theorem. The assigned proofs reproduce the needed arguments locally. The lecture's distinct anchored IRGNM section is not used as a premise for this unanchored LM theorem.

contents.name: Section 11.2, equations (11.14)–(11.16): the damped linearized least-squares minimizer, residual-forcing rule, and discrepancy stop

Lemma 11.9: exact one-step Fejér decrease under the range-approximation condition
Assumption 11.10 and Theorem 11.11: product-type tangential cone condition, local ball, finite stopping, and logarithmic iteration count
contents.locator: Chapter 11 §11.2, Assumption 11.10 and Theorem 11.11 complete proof through the residual contraction and logarithmic estimate.

contents.name: The source theorem's restriction to positive noise for finite discrepancy stopping
